raw_whole_json_valid: Counts JSON syntax validity only among eligible terminal text after technical/graph/native-tool-plan suppression, not every archived last message.
legacy_M_contract_compliant: Original-M exact two-string-key/nonempty-answer/300-character engineering schema, NOT every method own schema validity.
strict_correct: Matches cached published results under each method original output protocol; no historical prediction re-parsing/overwriting.
aligned_correct: Common explicit-answer adapter plus source-attributed choice accuracy or M4CXR-style textEM. No new model generation.
word_recall: Author-style reference-word-set recall over full denominator, with missing answers0; not answer accuracy.
legacy_seed0_correct: Separate parenthesized-choice parser sensitivity on extracted explicit answer text. Fixedseed0; random credit never enters main score. Missing explicit answers ineligible. Not exact paper reproduction.
